title: A Japanese-style card paid about two months after its close: two statements waiting at once, one paid late (decision I3)
story: One bank, set up Fri 11 Dec 2026 with 100,000, and one card paid in full from it. The card closes on the 15th and is paid on the 10th two months later, moved later on weekends: the 15 Nov statement is paid on Mon 11 Jan, the 15 Dec one on Wed 10 Feb. At setup the 15 Oct statement was already paid (10 Dec); the 15 Nov statement of 40,000 is waiting, and 15,000 has posted since. Pay of 250,000 on the 25th, moved earlier; rent of 200,000 on the 27th, moved later. From the 15 Dec close until 11 Jan two statements wait at once. The 15 Nov statement is paid late, on Thu 14 Jan, three days after its payment day and before the 15 Jan close. I3: 'carried over' means only statements not paid by their own payment day; a statement still waiting for its payment day is never folded into the next one. No holidays are listed. Every amount is made up.

opening.note: Current is the 40,000 statement plus 15,000 posted 16 Nov to 11 Dec. The 15 Oct statement was paid on 10 Dec, before setup.

jcard.why: 15,000 (posted 16 Nov to 11 Dec) + 5,000 (12 Dec) = 20,000; the 15 Nov statement waits for 11 Jan and is not in it
40,000 (the 15 Nov statement, not paid by 11 Jan) - 40,000 (paid 14 Jan) + 8,000 (5 Jan) = 8,000; the 15 Dec statement waits for 10 Feb and is not in it

events.note: the 15 Nov statement, due Mon 11 Jan, paid late

asks.question: card_due
asks.note: Two statements wait now: 15 Nov (40,000, 11 Jan) and 15 Dec (20,000, 10 Feb). The card shows the older one.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 150,000 (Bank today: 100,000 + 250,000 pay - 200,000 rent) - 40,000 (Card statement closed 15 Nov, paid 11 Jan) = 110,000
asks.note: The 15 Dec statement (20,000) comes off on 10 Feb, after the 25 Jan pay; nothing is counted twice: 40,000 + 20,000 is all that is owed.

why.money_out: 40,000 (the 15 Nov statement, due Mon 11 Jan, its posting window over on 12 Jan) = 40,000

asks.question: card_due
asks.note: The 15 Nov statement was still waiting for its 11 Jan payment day when the 15 Dec one closed, so it was never folded in (I3). Before I3 the model said 60,000.

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.note: Then the 25 Feb pay, rent on 1 Mar and the 8,000 statement on 10 Mar. Before I3 the model took 60,000 on 10 Feb: 100,000.

asks.question: card_due
asks.why: 40,000 (the 15 Nov statement, not paid by its 11 Jan payment day, so carried over) - 40,000 (paid late on 14 Jan, before this close) + 8,000 (spent 5 Jan) = 8,000
asks.note: Before I3 the model said 28,000: it held the 15 Dec statement in this one too.
